Backend logs confirm 'GHL lead_capture sent for ...' fires for each captured lead → GHL webhook target reachable. (2) ExitIntentModal — opens on desktop mouseout (clientY≤0, relatedTarget=null), shows '$25 off' heading + email input + submit, POSTs to /api/lead-capture, success state appears, sets localStorage 'pawhaus_exit_intent_seen'='1', does NOT re-trigger on reload. (3) Room price anchor — all 3 cards (petite $558→$391 save $167, standard $698→$489 save $209, monolith $898→$629 save $269) render strike-price (line-through), discount-price (clay), savings-badge (forest pill), and '+ free welcome bandana & spa treatment per dog (worth $40)' green perks line. (4) FounderSection — visible with /brand/garrett.webp image (51KB, naturalWidth>0), 3 paragraphs, 'Garrett' + 'PawHaus' in heading, 'Founder, PawHaus Resort • Cameron Ranch Glamping' label. (5) Booking regression — Standard Room → Step 2 (contact + 2026-12-15 + pet 'Bella' + Blueberry Facial perk) → Step 3 → Pay → live Stripe URL returned ('https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_live_...'). Did NOT click final pay button. Test leads + test bookings cleaned up (1 lead + 1 booking + 1 payment_transaction deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: ExitIntentModal.jsx uses deprecated e.toElement (line 44) alongside e.relatedTarget — toElement is non-standard and undefined in modern browsers, but the relatedTarget==null check is the actual trigger condition so this still works. Harmless but worth cleaning up.
MobileStickyBar.jsx attaches a scroll listener with no rAF throttle. Scroll handler fires on every scroll event — acceptable for a single setState toggle but could be debounced for very long pages.

ExitIntentModal.jsx silently swallows fetch errors in the catch block but still shows the success state only on the resolve path — good. However the modal does NOT validate the /api/lead-capture HTTP status; a 500 response would still set submitted=true. Minor.
Booking.jsx room-card data-testid pattern correctly uses 'room-card-{id}' but the spec called for direct selection — testid is consistent with prior iterations and passed all flows.
PRESERVED FROM ITER 2: ADMIN_TOKEN in plain .env, exposed via X-Admin-Token header — standard for this stage.
